Subject: Redwood — Post-call summary & mutual action plan (Acme Analytics)

Hi Maya / Tom —

Great to speak with you both today. Quick recap from our discovery and next steps so we stay aligned. I attached a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) PDF and also dropped the draft into the shared Drive link below.

Top takeaways from today
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood inference for customer-facing recommendation feature (throughput/latency and cost targets).
- Success criteria: P95 latency under 200ms @ 75% traffic, cost per 1M tokens under target X (we'll finalize).
- Technical scope: infra eval (integration with VPC), data handling, and quality checks (prompt sets + evals).

Proposed MAP (attached) — highlights
- Owners: infra eval (Acme infra lead), quality & evals (Product).
- Timeline: sandbox deployment within 2 weeks, formal eval 2–3 weeks after that.
- Deliverables: sandbox endpoint, sample eval results, infra checklist completed.

Immediate next steps
1) Please confirm the names/owners for: infra evaluation, security review, and procurement contact.
2) Tell us if the proposed timeline in the attached MAP works or if we should shift priorities.
3) I’ve looped in Vivek (SE) and Marissa (CS) to support technical setup and evaluation design.

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_Acme_Analytics_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmeEval
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/RDW-DEAL-2345

If it helps, we can book a 30-min sync to assign owners and lock dates — available Wed/Thu next week.

Thanks,
Aditya
